learning_outcomes.title: Evaluate step functions
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Evaluate the expression inside the floor brackets first.

questions.instruction: What is the value of the given expression? Evaluate the step function at the given value.
questions.stem: What is the value of the given expression? Evaluate the step function at the given value. f(x)=2\lfloor x-1\rfloor,\quad x=1.5

options.misconception: Use the stated radical, ratio or geometric rule; check reciprocal, sign, squared length and units.
Use the stated radical, ratio or geometric rule; check reciprocal, sign, squared length and units.

answer.explanation: Subtract 1, take the greatest integer less than or equal to that result, then multiply by 2.
